source_policy: Critical financial tables from signed issuer results visually reviewed. Management outlook is an issuer claim, not a verified future result. Original bytes, hashes and publication dates retained separately.
forecast_target: First reported December 2026 quarterly PAT at the selected issuer identity and consolidated/standalone scope, including the explicitly recorded owner attribution. No substitute EPS, total group PAT, adjusted PAT or annualized number.

outcome_policy.first_release: Read and capture the first quarterly release, not a later restatement. Record release date, review timestamp, original source URL, unit and identity.
outcome_policy.perimeter_changes: If the same selected issuer identity and accounting target still report a first-release figure, score that reported figure and flag the merger/demerger or other perimeter change separately. Do not use it for a post-hoc favorable exclusion. If no matching issuer/target genuinely exists, retain the attempted row as unavailable with an explicit reason. No silent pro-forma substitution.

comparison_policy.primary: assisted_driver versus normalized_seasonal_additive on identical observed rows
comparison_policy.mandatory_raw_check: Also report raw seasonal_additive. Normalized input adjustments may contain analyst tax or owner-allocation assumptions.
comparison_policy.older_frozen_comparisons: Separate diagnostics because information dates differ. Do not call the difference pure model/reasoning skill.
comparison_policy.error_scale: Original frozen max(1,abs(Q1 PAT),abs(Q2 PAT)), unchanged even where extraction was corrected.
comparison_policy.missingness: Every attempt is retained. Pairwise comparisons report available, observed and missing counts. No best-method selection after results.
comparison_policy.scenario_policy: Three explicit assumptions, no probabilities and no prediction-interval claim.
comparison_policy.cohort_limit: First twelve remaining original hash-ranked names, from a selected source-acquisition universe. Not a random sample of the Indian market.
comparison_policy.within_quarter: Recorded with the target quarter already in progress, not a quarter-start forecast.

cases.normalization_basis: Main historical comparators use reported owner PAT without discretionary addbacks. Disclosed exceptional items without an identified owner-level after-tax effect remain reported, with separate sensitivity where material.

cases.model_formula: (revenue_cr * ebit_margin + other_income_cr - finance_cost_cr + exceptional_pretax_cr) * (1 - tax_rate) + associates_after_tax_cr - nci_cr
cases.margin_definition: EBIT excluding other income and finance costs, after depreciation and amortisation. This is not EBITDA margin.
cases.rationale: Assume continuing finished-dosage and complex-generics throughput supports modest revenue growth, but persistent input/logistics pressure and peptide losses limit the profit increase. The base allows financing benefit from the stronger cash position while preserving meaningful financing costs. It is deliberately below the seasonal additive and YoY-ratio forecasts because those do not encode current margin pressure.

favorable.assumptions: Better cost recovery and complex-generics mix, revenue 1700 cr and EBIT margin 17%, alongside modest financing benefit. No named approval or exclusivity gain is assumed.

cases.scenario_interpretation: Analyst-defined adverse, base and favorable assumptions. These are not probability bounds, calibrated prediction intervals, management guidance or price targets. Outcomes can fall outside the range.
limits: A within-quarter fundamental forecast with no realized target-quarter outcome.
The forecast does not constitute full valuation, governance, cash-conversion or position-sizing underwriting.
Seasonal anchors use one prior year and can break when business mix changes.
cases.rationale: Fee income is seasonal and variable, fair-value gains are unpredictable, and minority interests absorb a material part of group profit. The base allows fee recovery from September but does not extrapolate the Q1 fair-value gain or use group PAT as owner earnings.

verified_facts.fact: Q2 fee revenue 36.44cr, fee expense 15.34cr, employee costs 14.91cr and P&L fair-value gain 0.86cr. Q1 fair-value gain was 10.18cr.
Q2 own PBT 5.91cr plus associates 6.27cr minus tax 1.27cr gives group PAT 10.91cr, while the owner-PAT line is 7.57cr and NCI 3.33cr. The source rounds individual lines to whole lakh.
Prior December fee revenue was 53.07cr versus prior September 30.86cr. Prior December group PAT 15.30cr included 6.13cr NCI, leaving 9.17cr owner PAT.

assumptions.label: Fee revenue
assumptions.basis: Above current Q2 but below prior Q3. One seasonal observation is a weak anchor, and no current-quarter deal pipeline was verified.

assumptions.label: Fee expense
assumptions.basis: Near current Q2 15.34 / 36.44. Mix can move this ratio.

assumptions.label: Employee and overhead expense
assumptions.basis: Allow current higher payroll to persist, with seasonal overhead above current Q2 5.12cr.

assumptions.label: Fair-value gain
assumptions.basis: No directional forecast. The downside assumes a 3cr loss and favorable case a 3cr gain.

assumptions.label: Associates and NCI
assumptions.basis: NCI is a material explicit assumption, not a fixed group ownership percentage. Entity-level profit mix was not forecast separately.

assumptions.label: Tax
assumptions.basis: Applied to own PBT only. No tax benefit is recognized in the adverse loss scenario.

cases.rounding_note: The signed statement displays whole INR lakh. Group PAT minus separately rounded NCI can differ from reported owner PAT by 0.01-0.02cr. The owner-PAT row remains the target and source of historical inputs.
disconfirming_evidence_to_watch: Fee income remaining near 36cr despite seasonal expectations would compress the base profit sharply.
A change in the subsidiary earnings mix can move owner PAT even with unchanged group PAT.
Fair-value movements can overwhelm the modest operating forecast.
cases.main_takeaway: Forecast owner earnings through the operating mix and NCI, rather than scaling headline group profit.
